parameters.description:
`msg-to-misskey` accepts an HTTP POST carrying the unified `msg` envelope (`title`, `body`, `type`, `format`), attaches the credentials in your stored secrets, and delivers the message to your Misskey instance — so you run no messaging infrastructure of your own.

Delivery goes out through a native gateway transformation that posts straight to your own Misskey instances — free, and driven entirely by the credentials you have stored. Paid variants ($0.001 / message) deliver to additional Misskey instances bound per enrollment.

Create an account on a Misskey instance (e.g. misskey.io, or any server listed at misskey-hub.net/en/instances.html), then go to Settings → Service Integration → Generate Access Token. Name the token whatever you like, grant it at least the "Compose or delete notes" permission, and set the generated token as MISSKEY_TOKEN.
parameters.gateway_plus_price_description: $0.001 per message — extra per-enrollment Misskey destinations, direct
parameters.gateway_price_description: Free — direct to your Misskey instance
parameters.summary: Send a notification to your own Misskey instance by posting a simple `msg` request to the UnitySVC gateway.

token_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's Misskey token
